prompt.project_info: Ultra-realistic golden-hour portrait on a rocky seashore.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman using the attached identity reference, with preserved facial structure, skin tone, body type and hair texture, seated barefoot on a large coastal rock in a black sleeveless summer dress with fitted torso and slightly flared skirt; calm slightly serious direct gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 4:5 full-body front-facing portrait, legs extended and slightly bent, one hand resting on knee and one near face, textured rocks, shallow water, distant mountains and soft blue clouded sky behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused golden-hour side light from right, warm hair and skin highlights, gentle shadows, clear serene coastal atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens look, moderate depth of field, sharp eyes, high-resolution editorial realism, natural skin texture and slightly warm cinematic grading.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 4:5 ultra-realistic coastal editorial portrait using the attached approved-adult identity reference exactly: the woman sits barefoot on a large textured rock in a black sleeveless summer dress with fitted torso and slightly flared skirt, legs extended and slightly bent, one hand on knee and one gently touching her face, calm direct gaze; golden-hour natural light, rocky shore, shallow water, distant mountains and soft blue sky, 50mm realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, altered identity, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay
